name: Masking scent (humanoid)
body:
Masking scent
Source Advanced Class Guide pg. 207
Price 25 gp (animal), 50 gp (humanoid), 100 gp (magical beast); Weight — (animal), — (humanoid), — (magical beast)
Description
This item comes in a variety of scents (matching any one animal, humanoid, or magical beast). One vial applied to a single Medium-sized creature changes its scent to that of the masking scent’s creature for 8 hours.
Construction
Craft (Alchemy) DC 25
